title: NextAction
description: One decision the engine reached, with the evidence it rests on. Stored so it can be verified later and argued with — an engine that always has an opinion is indistinguishable from one that is right, until you check.

actionType.description: Priority order is exactly this array order (0 = highest). REDUCE_ASSISTANCE outranks remediation: if a learner's accepted work came off code-bearing hints, every skill conclusion drawn from it is built on sand. DIAGNOSE is the DEFAULT and the most common answer, because ~75% of failures carry no attributable cause.

reason.description: Plain-language, built from the same counts as the decision.

confidence.description: Confidence in THIS DECISION, not in any misconception. The two are different numbers and conflating them is how a system starts asserting things.

difficulty.description: A DIRECTION for a catalogue query to resolve, not a measured level. Per-task difficulty calibration does not exist.

requires.description: A property the task's own verification evidence must have. Asking someone to practise edge cases on a task with no degenerate case is not practice.

expectedOutcome.description: What we expect to observe if this worked. Falsifiable on purpose — this is what makes action effectiveness measurable rather than assumed.
